recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-13230; any future gateway-extension wording work should be handled in the extension-pack/device-gateway family rather than by adding redundant local prose to Observation.device.
issue_request: FHIR-13230 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 by Orders and Observations. It reported that the Observation.device comment incorrectly said devices supporting an observation could be represented through Observation.related, whose target could not reference Device, and the final resolution directed removal of the Observation.related wording.
initial_application: Commit 2bc0950a1e354c2a99db1fca80954166c25bc241 applied the Jira-tagged correction in 2017 by replacing the Observation.device spreadsheet comment's extension-or-Observation.related wording with extension-or-Provenance gateway wording. Commit 67f44190f459a16621371d8e00dbffe9f7e52f1e later rewrote that same comment into the current gateway/Provenance sentence.
additional_context: Observation is active in the current build's source/fhir.ini [resources] list, and source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml is the current authoritative source. The related FHIR-13144/GF#13144 issue and linked Zulip PGD discussion support distinguishing the measuring device from gateway/mobile applications and using Provenance, AuditEvent, or extension approaches for the latter. A repository-wide exact-text check found the old Observation.related wording only in source/media/media-spreadsheet.xml; Media is not active in source/fhir.ini [resources], so that retired artifact does not require a core Observation fix for this seed.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the active Observation.device source already omits the incorrect Observation.related recommendation and instead says gateway/transmission devices may be documented with Provenance where relevant.

related_jiras.note: Published companion issue about identifying personal-health gateway/mobile devices; it supports the current Provenance/gateway interpretation but was not independently reconciled by this seed.
